topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: The trail has split, and where once we walked together, now the ground lies bare where my paws have tread alone. The air carries the scent of change, the leaves whisper of time that has passed, and the river flows without pause, washing away the marks of our shared paths. I stand at the fork, where memory and the present day diverge, and I look ahead, knowing that some journeys must be taken alone, even as the heart reaches back for what was lost to the currents of time.
